programme.title: Put your car on TV
programme.desc: The Walk' at JBR, the most prestigious location in Dubai, sets the background for the fastest customized cars in the Middle East. Put Your Car on TV invites car owners to present their cars and have it judged. The owner of the fastest, most beautiful and best sounding car wins a special treat from Sofitel Dubai Jumeirah Beach. Among the competitors are a Lamborghini Aventador and a GMC Chevrolet.

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: James Dean teria sido um grande fã do novo Porsche Boxter, um verdadeiro carro esportivo de teto aberto. A Volkswagen apresenta o novo Passat Alltrack, um verdadeiro "allrounder".

programme.title: Perfect Ride
programme.desc: Nous avons conduit une voiture de la sous-marque DS de Citroën, qui tente de s'imposer en Formule E. Citroën et Peugeot partagent la même plateforme avec leurs modèles Rifter et Berlingo. Et : le facelift de la 508, le vaisseau amiral de Peugeot.

programme.title: Put your car on TV
programme.desc: Once more, Mylene Gomera and Saif Hattawi are on the hunst for the most amazing cars in the world and ask car owners to bring their customized vehicles to Dubai, where it will be awarded points based on speed, style and sound. The car with the points wins a stay at the Sofitel Hotel Dubai Jumeirah Beach for two people. Among the presented cars are a limited edition Mercedes SLS and an Audi R8.

programme.title: Lotus Elise vs. Roding Roadster
programme.desc: Une route de col de montagne quelque part en Europe centrale. Deux voitures de sport légères en duel : la Lotus Elise et le Roding Roadster.

programme.title: Mercedes Sprinter, 2018
programme.desc: O Mercedes Sprinter pertence à classe dos veículos comerciais. O transportador leve é o sonho de todo negociante. A terceira geração do Sprinter é mais elegante, mais moderna e mais variável do que nunca.

programme.title: Audi R8, 2018
programme.desc: Der V10 Sauger im R8 ist einer der letzten seiner Art. Vielleicht ist dies der letzte V10 aus dem Hause Audi. Es wird sogar gemunkelt, dass es der letzte R8 sein könnte. Also sollte man um so mehr noch einmal die geballte Power von 620 PS und 580 Nm in der Performace Quattro Version (ehemals V10 plus) auskosten.

programme.title: La dernière de son espèce : Lamborghini Jalpa avec V8 à moteur central

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: A McLaren é uma das marcas de automóveis mais famosas da Grã-Bretanha. Quase não há carros esportivos que fascinem tanto quanto uma McLaren ou que tenham uma herança tão lendária no automobilismo. Dois modelos recentes da McLaren são o 650S e a série limitada P1. Os supercarros estão com vontade de amar e namorar o 650S da McLaren em uma antiga área industrial e na pista de corrida.

programme.title: Supercars
programme.desc: Extreme Leistung oder extravaganter Luxus, diese Zutaten machen aus einem herkömmlichen Auto ein Supercar. Im Luxus-Segment führt kein Weg an den Engländern vorbei: Rolls-Royce und Bentley sind die ultimativen Statussymbole. Wer es sportlich mag, hat mittlerweile eine große Auswahl. Bugatti, Ferrari, Lamborghini, Porsche, McLaren und Co. liefern sich einen Kampf um den besten Sportwagen der Welt. Supercars präsentiert die Autos für die oberen 10.000.

programme.title: Streetwise
programme.desc: Aujourd'hui, il s'agit d'un poids léger dans le segment de la classe supérieure allemande, l'A6 2.0 TDI d'Audi. Plus d'efficacité, moins de poids et plus de sportivité, voilà ce que promeut le constructeur pour gagner la course contre BMW et Mercedes.

programme.title: Put your car on TV

programme.title: Supercars

programme.title: Supercars

Begleitet von einem atemberaubenden Sound und enormer Fahrleistung bildet der R8 Spyder die perfekte Symbiose aus Sportlichkeit und Open-Air-Fahrspaß.

En 1964, Ferruccio Lamborghini voulait créer la meilleure voiture de sport au monde, une décision audacieuse, étant situé à seulement quelques kilomètres de Ferrari. Malgré cela, son premier modèle, la 350GT, a fait mieux que la concurrence de Maranello. Et beaucoup d'autres ont suivi.

programme.title: Motorheads
programme.desc: In 1964, Ferruccio Lamborghini set himself the goal to build the best sports cars in the world, a bold move, being located only a few kilometers from Ferrari.

programme.title: Motorheads

programme.title: Motorheads
programme.desc: After the Second World War, following in his father's footsteps who had been responsible for the development of the classic Volkswagen, Ferry Porsche laid the foundation for the brand's sports car models like the 356 and later the Porsche 911.

programme.title: Motorheads

Une Ruf sera néanmoins toujours plus rapide et plus unique qu’une Porsche qui lui ressemble.

programme.desc: Dès le début de l'histoire de l'entreprise, AMG s'est fixé pour objectif d'être l'incarnation des performances automobiles de pointe, de l'exclusivité et du plaisir de conduite dynamique sous le signe de l'étoile Mercedes.

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: The IAA in Frankfurt is the largest motor show in the world. More than 900 exhibitors present their new products in 11 halls and on 14 outdoor areas. Here you can marvel at tomorrow's trends today.

programme.title: FIM Supermoto World & European Championship
programme.desc: A terceira etapa, o Grand Prix of Germany, leva as equipes e os fãs à cidade de St. Wendel, no estado do Sarre.

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: The tuning forge SKN from Benstorf is organising a Dyno Day for the second time. Also: Lorinser refines the Mercedes E 500 Coupé. And: an invitation to Raeder Motorsport.

programme.title: Motorcycles
programme.desc: Der leichteste Power Cruiser, das Serienmotorrad mit dem größten Hubraum weltweit und ein phänomenaler Allrounder: die Ducati Diavel mit 162 PS und einem Gewicht von kaum mehr als 200 Kilogramm, die Triumph Rocket III Touring mit 2,3 Litern Hubraum und die KTM 990 SM-T, eine erstaublich vielseitige Mischung aus Supermoto und Touring-Bike.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: Des succès légendaires en course, des innovations technologiques et des véhicules exclusifs ont contribué à la renommée mondiale de la marque Lancia. Son histoire a été marquée par des hauts et des bas, mais Lancia est toujours tenue en haute estime.

programme.title: FIM Supermoto World & European Championship
programme.desc: Para a quarta etapa, o Grand Prix of Hungary, iremos para Visonta, no nordeste do país.

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: Patrick Simon tests the Aston Martin Zagato on the Grand Prix circuit. Also: Renault Megane Sport vs. Golf GTI Edition 35. And: the Porsche 997 and 994 on the Nordschleife.

programme.title: Motorcycles
programme.desc: Frühjahrserwachen bei Motorcycles: Die wichtigsten aktuellen Motorrad-Trends spüren wir auf einer der vielen Bike-Messen auf, der IMOT in München. Große Reise-Enduros, Maxi-Scooter und Vernunftbikes liegen voll im Trend, dazu die neuesten Versionen von Supersportlern. Daneben testen wir erstmals die brandneuen Maxi-Scooter von BMW.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: La division BMW Motorsport est une histoire à succès depuis sa création, et pas seulement sur les circuits de course. Les voitures de route hautes performances portant la lettre M à l'arrière ont suscité dès le début un enthousiasme mondial.

programme.title: FIM Supermoto World & European Championship
programme.desc: Busca, no Piemonte, é o local da quinta etapa da competição deste ano, o Grand Prix de Piemonte.

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: Once a year, Las Vegas hosts the largest car and tuning trade show in the world - the SEMA Show. We show the highlights from hot rods to custom cars.

programme.title: Motorcycles
programme.desc: Wir testen verschiedene Dreiräder für große Jungs: Zunächst Trikes mit bis zu 200 PS starkem Auto-Motor im Heck und den dreirädrigen Motorroller MP3 von Piaggio, der mit zwei Vorderreifen mehr Grip hat als jeder andere Scooter.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: Les voitures de la marque emblématique Saab sont élégantes, excentriques et ont un certain flair suédois. Saab a construit des voitures différentes des autres : avec des formes idiosyncratiques, une technologie innovante et une sécurité exemplaire.

programme.title: FIM Supermoto World & European Championship
programme.desc: Para a sexta etapa, o S1GP of Nations, as equipes viajam para Vysoké Mýto, na República Tcheca.

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: The car tuner Lorinser looks back on more than 30 years of experience in tuning Mercedes Benz cars. Also: aeroplane vs. Porsche GT3. And: in an Aston Martin on the Nordschleife.

programme.title: Motorcycles
programme.desc: Diesmal in Motorcycles: Motorradfahren Made in England. Da darf DIE britische Kultmarke schlechthin natürlich nicht fehlen, Triumph. Wir testen die Tiger 800 und die Tiger 1050. Mit ihr bieten die Engländer ein absolutes Funbike, das mit typischem Triple und strammer Abstimmung konkurrenzfähiger ist denn je. Und um dem british way of drive weiter auf den Grund zu gehen, ist Schottland das Ziel einer Motorrad-Tour: In die Highlands mit einer BMW R 1200 RT.

programme.title: Car History
programme.desc: Dans les années 1960 et 1970, Ford a construit une voiture classique après l'autre, en suivant toujours la formule éprouvée de l'entreprise : technologie simple, formes attrayantes, prix abordable.

programme.title: FIM Supermoto World & European Championship
programme.desc: Para a sétima e última etapa da temporada 2025, o Grand Prix of Belgium, vamos para Mettet, na região da Valônia.

programme.title: Tuning
programme.desc: The Essen Motor Show is the event for automobile and motor sports enthusiasts. Over 300,000 visitors flock here every year and bring the hallowed halls to a boil.

programme.title: Ken Block bei der Rallyecross Weltmeisterschaft
programme.desc: Ken Block, ein Allroundtalent! In der Rallyecross Weltmeisterschaft fahrt er gegen die besten Rallyefahrer der Welt.

programme.title: Peugeot 108 vs Renault Twingo
programme.desc: Peugeot 108 et Renault Twingo, les deux françaises sont assez similaires, et pourtant fondamentalement différentes. La largement moins coûteuse Peugot 108 est la voiture parfaite pour ceux qui veulent épargner leur porte-monnaie. Mais la 108 a un sérieux adversaire avec la troisième génération de Renault Twingo.

programme.title: An Bord des Mclaren 570S Spider
programme.desc: Wir fahren mit dem McLaren 570S Spider ein wenig durchs Gebirge und geniessen den schönen Tag.

programme.title: Crash
programme.desc: Quando a ambição excede a capacidade de dirigir e quando os profissionais de corrida bem seguros são levados para fora da curva, então nós estamos lá com a câmera. Truques de tirar o fôlego de motoristas profissionais e tapas por balas de metal de alta potência. Cenas espetaculares nas quais ninguém é prejudicado.

programme.title: Suzuki V-Strom 650
programme.desc: Sie ist der perfekte Allrounder. Die Suzuki V-Strom 650. Ob als Enduro, Tourer oder Sortlerin. Sie macht immer eine sehr gute Figur.

programme.title: Une voiture unique : La Beradino
programme.desc: Une "Bella Macchina" sur quatre roues – bien qu’elle ne soit pas conçue par des maîtres tels que Bertone ou Pininfarina. Johannes Paulussen de Neuss, en Allemagne, a construit cette voiture de ses mains.

programme.title: Porsche Ruf RT35
programme.desc: Ruf RT35 may look like a Porsche, but it really isn't. Since 1981, the Ruf company in Pfaffhausen, Germany, has been recognized as an independent manufacturer. But the basis for its vehicles comes exclusively from Porsche. A Ruf is even faster and more exclusive than a comparable Porsche.

programme.title: Put your car on TV
programme.sub-title: Chevrolet Camaro e Mercedes SLS AMG
programme.desc: Os carros maníacos são convidados a trazer os seus veículos afinados para "The Walk" na Praia de Jumeirah para serem julgados em termos de velocidade, estilo e som. Neste episódio, um Chevrolet Camaro e um Mercedes SLS AMG tentarão uau.

programme.title: New Zealand Rally Championship
programme.desc: Rally Coromandel führt die NZRC auf spektakuläre Küsten-Schotterstraßen, wo Tempo, Präzision und Konstanz zählen. Im heißen Titelkampf entscheidet jede Prüfung und jede Sekunde in diesem intensiven Saisonmittelpunkt.

programme.title: 4x4
programme.desc: Trois frères issus de la même plateforme Volkswagen : le Skoda Kodiaq offre de l'espace pour sept personnes, le Volkswagen Tiguan est plus cher mais offre une gamme plus large de moteurs, et Seat apporte la passion espagnole au segment des SUV.

programme.title: Motorvision Specials
programme.desc: The Yas Marina Circuit in Abu Dhabi is the most glamorous race track of the Formula One. Khaled Qubaysi takes us for a spin on this exclusive behind-the-scenes look at the famous race track.

programme.title: Motorvision Specials
programme.sub-title: Team X-Raid at the Dakar Rally
programme.desc: Stéphane Peterhansel is the most successful driver in the history of the Dakar Rally. With the German team X-Raid he won the 2012 and 2013 editions of this prestigious competition in a Mini Countryman.

programme.title: 4x4
programme.desc: La Jaguar XF-S est censée mettre la pression sur BMW, Audi et les autres concurrents du segment de la classe business. Volvo adopte une approche différente. La S90 impressionne par son design scandinave et ses moteurs quatre cylindres économiques.

programme.title: Put your car on TV
programme.desc: Coloque o seu carro na TV convida os proprietários de automóveis a serem avaliados por Saif Hattawi. A pessoa com mais pontos ganhará um presente especial do Sofitel Dubai Jumeirah Beach. Inclui: um BMW X5 e um Mercedes SLK 230.

programme.title: New Zealand Rally Championship
programme.desc: Die Rally Bay of Plenty liefert packende NZRC-Action, während Top-Teams auf anspruchsvollen Schotterstrecken um Punkte kämpfen. Tempo, Technik und Wendungen bestimmen das Geschehen auf dem Weg zum Saisonhöhepunkt.

programme.title: 4x4
programme.desc: ORZ Vehicles, une entreprise allemande spécialisée dans la production, la vente et l'installation de pièces Jeep, fait du rêve américain du tout-terrain une réalité. Un bon exemple de cette approche est le Brute, une version pick-up du Wrangler.

programme.title: Put your car on TV
programme.sub-title: Honda Accord e um carro cheio de cristais
programme.desc: As pessoas no Médio Oriente são loucas pelos seus carros. Em Put Your Car na TV, podem apresentar os seus veículos sintonizados e classificados. Os concorrentes de hoje incluem uma Nova SS, um Honda Acord especial e um carro cheio de cristais.

programme.title: 4x4
programme.desc: Le Seat Arona est un SUV compact typique. Un autre pseudo tout-terrain est le T-Roc de Volkswagen. Le plus petit SUV de Volkswagen pourra-t-il réitérer le succès du Tiguan ? En plus : les concurrents asiatiques Hyundai Kona, KIA Stonic et Toyota C-HR.

programme.title: Motorvision Specials
programme.desc: For more than a century man and machine have tried to tame the Pikes Peak mountain, where daredevils risk everything to be the fastest up the 20-kilometer road to the summit at 4,300 meters above sea level. We show you the highlights of the 2018 race.

programme.title: Bentley Bentayga
programme.desc: Com a Bentley Bentayga, a tradicional marca britânica está entrando no segmento de mercado que mais cresce. Este primeiro SUV de luxo do mundo é um conglomerado de superlativos sobre rodas.

programme.title: Mercedes Sprinter, 2018
programme.desc: O Mercedes Sprinter pertence à classe dos veículos comerciais. O transportador leve é o sonho de todo negociante. A terceira geração do Sprinter é mais elegante, mais moderna e mais variável do que nunca.

programme.title: New Zealand Rally Championship
programme.desc: Die International Rally of Whangarei bringt die NZRC-Saison 2025 zu einem spannenden Finale. Auf Weltklasse-Schotter kämpfen die besten Teams um den Sieg und die Chance, sich in einem dramatischen Saisonabschluss den Titel zu sichern.

programme.title: 4x4
programme.desc: Quando o fabricante britânico Land Rover decidiu terminar a sua produção do icónico Defensor após mais de 60 anos, era necessário determinar um sucessor. Visualmente, poderia ser modelado após o Discovery, cuja quinta geração é uma mistura de veículo todo-o-terreno e SUV de luxo. Também: o SsangYong Rexton, o Jeep Renegade e a nossa escolha dos 5 melhores veículos todo-o-terreno.

programme.title: 4x4
programme.desc: Lorsque Land Rover a décidé d'arrêter la production du Defender après plus de 60 ans, il fallait lui trouver un successeur. Et aussi : le SsangYong Rexton, le Jeep Renegade et notre sélection des 5 meilleurs tout-terrain.

programme.title: Motorvision Specials
programme.desc: Former World Rally champion Armin Schwarz is a legend behind the wheel. We accompanied him when he instructed other talented drivers in a Subaru WRX STI rally car in the snowy and icy, but also breathtaking landscape of Finland.

programme.title: 4x4
programme.sub-title: Alpina B5 Touring contra Jaguar XF Sportbrake
programme.desc: O Audi RS6 e o Mercedes E63 AMG são os dois melhores esportistas entre os vagões de estação. A BMW parece ter desistido da corrida, mas o afinador de alto desempenho Alpina surgiu com o B5 Twin Turbo, sua resposta baseada na BMW para a forte competição. Também: o ágil e confiável Skoda Octavia Combi. E: o Jaguar XF Sportbrake, um vagão de estação para individualistas.

programme.title: L’unité spéciale automobile de la police de Dubaï
programme.desc: Pour la première fois, l’unité spéciale automobile de la police de Dubaï autorise une équipe de télévision à accompagner ses officiers en patrouille. Ce ne sont pas des voitures de police normales, car il ne s’agit pas d’une ville normale.

programme.title: Motorvision Specials
programme.desc: The Tourist Trophy on the British Isle of Man is the most famous motorcycle race in the world. TT Sidecar champion Klaus Klaffenböck and racing expert Lenz Leberkern explore the fascination behind this exciting and iconic racing event.

programme.title: Crash
programme.desc: When ambition exceeds driving ability and when well-secured racing pros are carried out of the bend, we are there with the camera. Breathtaking stunts of professional drivers and slapsticks of high-powered sheet metal bullets. Spectacular scenes in which no one is harmed.

programme.title: Crash
programme.sub-title: Mamas lasst eure Babys keine Rallyefahrer werden
programme.desc: When ambition exceeds driving ability and when well-secured racing pros are carried out of the bend, we are there with the camera. Breathtaking stunts of professional drivers and slapsticks of high-powered sheet metal bullets. Spectacular scenes in which no one is harmed.

programme.title: BMW M3 E30 – La BMW la plus appréciée de tous les temps
programme.desc: À la fin des années 80, BMW a mis sur le marché une voiture dont la course était l'ADN. Conçue au départ comme un modèle d'homologation pour le Deutsche Tourenwagen Masters, le DTM, elle est finalement devenue l’une des voitures de sport les plus appréciée. Lorsqu’on invoque son nom, les fans de voiture en ont des frissons encore aujourd’hui : la BMW M3.

programme.title: Porsche Panamera Sport Turismo
programme.desc: We take out the Porsche Panamera Sport Turismo for a couple of rounds

programme.title: Cars & Life
programme.desc: Mit dem E-Tron S erweitert Audi seine Flotte an Fahrzeugen mit Elektroantrieb und liefert gleichzeitig ein leistungsstarkes Sportback-Modell. Außerdem: der Brandlhof bei Salzburg ist einer der größten Offroad-Parks in Europa. Toyota bietet dort etwas ganz Besonderes: eine Fahrschule, wo SUV- und Geländewagenfahrer*innen abseits vom Asphalt ihre Fähigkeiten im Gelände schärfen können. Und: die dritte Generation des Porsche Panamera.

programme.title: Put your car on TV
programme.desc: Mylene Gomera et Saif Hattawi invitent les fans de voiture du Moyen-Orient à montrer leurs voitures préparées sur "The Walk" à Jumeirah Beach afin qu’elles y soient notées selon leur vitesse, apparence, et bruit. Le vainqueur remporte une nuit pour deux personnes au Sofitel Dubai Jumeirah Beach. Dans cet épisode, une Chevrolet Camaro et une Mercedes SLS AMG s'affrontent.

programme.title: 4x4
programme.desc: Quem é o rei das caminhonetes fora da estrada? Os especialistas off-road da Delta 4x4 transformaram um Volkswagen Amarol em sua chamada Besta e desafiaram o especialista off-road da Toyota Alexander Wohlfarth em sua Toyota Hilux. Qual destas motorizadas 4x4 tem melhor preço em terrenos difíceis e ainda oferece adequação suficiente para o uso diário?

programme.title: Cars & Life
programme.desc: Seit seiner Markeinführung im Jahr 2002 schreibt der Porsche Cayenne seine eigene Erfolgsgeschichte im SUV-Segment. Wir haben die dritte Generation dieses beliebten Klassikers unter die Lupe genommen. Außerdem: auch Alfa Romeo folgt mit dem Stelvio dem SUV-Trend und legt ein Update des Luxus-SUV nach.

programme.title: Put your car on TV
programme.desc: Si vous voulez voir des voitures incroyables, des véhicules de luxe customisés ou préparés, ou des voitures chics, vous devez aller sur "The Walk", le célèbre boulevard de Jumeirah Beach. Put Your Car on TV invite les propriétaires de voitures à être jugés par Saif Hattawi.Le vainqueur remporte un séjour au Soiftel Dubai Jumeirah Beach. BMW X5 et Mercedes SLK 230 sont au programme du jour.

programme.title: Cadillac Escalade
programme.desc: O Cadillac Escalade a princípio parece um típico carro americano bastante carnudo, mas este luxuoso SUV é mais um gigante amável e gentil, que deve ser capaz de ganhar simpatia com sua clientela.

programme.title: Seat Alhambra
programme.desc: Embora o Seat Alhambra não pareça particularmente esportivo, mas quando testado por dois ciclistas profissionais, ele mostra que não deve ser subestimado.

programme.title: BMW Active Hybrid 7
programme.desc: With the Active Hybrid 7, unlike with its predecessor bearing the same model name, BMW now banks on a full hybrid, which can also be driven solely with electric power.

programme.title: Maserati Quattroporte GTS
programme.desc: 1963, over 50 years ago, with the Quattroporte Maserati invented a new vehicle category, the sports sedan. This GTS model is already the 6th generation of this iconic car.

programme.title: KIA Sorento
programme.desc: O Sorento é o principal veículo da linha de modelos da KIA. O fabricante coreano espera conquistar o mercado de SUV premium, oferecendo boa qualidade a um preço atrativo. O Sorento atende aos padrões de um veículo de primeira classe?

programme.title: Trackmasters
programme.desc: Neste episódio, convidamos você a testemunhar o progresso do motorista Uwe Nittle ao se preparar para a qualificação no Truck Grand Prix.

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: The 1971 BMW 02 Touring was considered an ugly duckling at the time, but is now a coveted car. Also: the solid technology and moderate prices of the Mercedes-Benz 114/115 made them the first "people's Mercedes".

programme.title: Put your car on TV
programme.desc: Les gens du Moyen-Orient sont fous de leurs voitures. Dans Put Your Car on TV, ils peuvent présenter et voir jugés leurs véhicules. Ils reçoivent des points selon la vitesse, l’apparence et le bruit, et le propriétaire ayant obtenu le plus de points remporte un séjour pour deux au Sofitel Dubai Jumeirah Beach. Aujourd’hui, une Nova SS, une Honda Acord et une voiture remplie de cristaux!

programme.title: Cars & Life
programme.desc: Anlässlich des 125-jährigen Firmenjubiläums von Skoda blicken wir zurück auf die ereignisreiche Geschichte eines der ältesten Automobilherstellers der Welt. Außerdem: unser Praxistest des Volkswagen ID.3, des ersten reinen Elektroautos von VW. Und: der McLaren 720S Spider, es gibt den Supersportwagen jetzt auch als Cabrio.

programme.title: Trackmasters
programme.desc: O Desafio RCN é a derradeira experiência de condução da BMW. Fizemos também uma visita ao Devils Diner, o ponto de encontro interno da pista para os motoristas.

programme.title: Classic Ride
programme.desc: In the 1950s, companies like Tatra from Czechoslovakia introduced advanced, even pioneering automobiles. The clientele was exclusive, which is why now these streamlined cars are big rarities. We tracked down the owner of a 1937 Tatra T87.

programme.title: Trio Harley Davidson
programme.desc: Dyna Switchback, Sportster 72 et Softail Slim étaient les noms des nouvelles Harley présentées dans les salles d'exposition. Elles s'adressaient à des groupes cibles complètement différents, ce que chacune des trois motos a réussi à faire à sa manière.

programme.title: Cars & Life
programme.desc: Neben der klassischen Sportback-Variante bietet Audi den A3 auch als Limousine an. Wir unterzogen dieses Modell einem ausführlichen Praxistest. Außerdem: der Lexus RX, die überarbeitete Variante des Premium-SUV von Toyotas Edelmarke auf dem Testgelände auf Ibiza. Und: auch Volkswagen legt mit einer neuen Modellvariante des e-Up! nach.

programme.title: Mercedes S63 AMG Coupé : Quand la beauté a un nom
programme.desc: La version coupé de la Mercedes Classe S est probablement l'un des plus beaux véhicules de son époque. Comme la S 63, le coupé devient une machine à conduire de 585 ch sans égal.

programme.title: Trackmasters
programme.desc: Após o término da corrida de 24 horas, deixamos o Nürburgring e nos mudamos para Büren, Alemanha, onde a empresa Raeder Motorsport está sediada. Eles são famosos pela tração dianteira com um grande desempenho que coloca uma grande potência na pista.

programme.title: McCanick - Bis in den Tod
programme.desc: Der kleinkriminelle Simon Weeks wird nach sieben Jahren aus dem Gefängnis entlassen - sehr zum Verdruss des in die Jahre gekommenen Drogenfahnders Eugene "Mack" McCanick, der einst zusammen mit seinem Boss Quinn für dessen Verhaftung verantwortlich war. Doch Weeks kennt ein dunkles Geheimnis aus Macks Vergangenheit. Also hängt Mack sich zusammen mit seinem Partner Floyd an dessen Fersen.

programme.title: Paranormal Vitality
programme.desc: Im März 2006 startet die Ärztin Dr. Helen Jara ein gewagtes Experiment: Sie will beweisen, dass einige Formen der Schizophrenie ihren Ursprung in der Paranormalität haben. Dafür versammelt sie mit Hilfe des Parapsychologen Matías Kram fünf Patienten in einem Haus, in dem es schon zu vielen übernatürlichen Geschehnissen gekommen ist. Doch der Horror steht den Beteiligten in Gestalt von Ainara, der jüngsten der Patientinnen, erst noch bevor...

programme.title: Hotel New Hampshire
programme.desc: Der Film erzählt von einer Familie, die alle Arten von Katastrophen übersteht und trotz alledem weitermacht. Er ist bekannt für seine wunderbare Auswahl an skurrilen Charakteren.

programme.title: Batman & Bill
programme.desc: Eine geheime Identität ist in der Welt der Superhelden nichts Besonderes. Doch dass hinter den Kulissen von Batman selbst die Geschichte einer geheimen Identität schlummert, ist lange nur absoluten Insidern geläufig gewesen. Diese Dokumentation geht der Frage nach wer die versteckten Urheber der ikonischen Comic-Figur sind.

programme.title: Das Komplott - Verrat auf höchster Ebene
programme.desc: Der frischgebackene argentinische Präsident Hernán Blanco sieht seine Regierung Korruptionsvorwürfen ausgesetzt, die vom Ex-Mann seiner Tochter Marina ausgehen. Als er sie deshalb einfliegen lässt, erleidet die junge Frau kurz darauf einen Nervenzusammenbruch. Ein Psychiater versetzt sie in Hypnose, und dabei offenbaren sich mysteriöse Erinnerungen, die Marina gar nicht haben dürfte.

programme.title: Das Urteil
programme.desc: Bei einem schweren Verkehrsunfall verliert Anwalt McClain seine Frau und seine beiden Söhne. Er selbst überlebt. Doch sein Dasein erscheint ihm nun völlig sinnlos. Aber dann übernimmt er den Fall eines jungen Mannes, der wegen Mordes zum Tod verurteilt werden soll. Während er vor Gericht für das Leben seines Klienten kämpft, findet er selbst allmählich ins Leben zurück. Dabei hilft ihm auch die verständnisvolle Anna, eine kompetente Psychologin und Seelsorgerin, die vor Jahren selbst einen schweren Verlust verarbeiten musste. Mit ihrer Hilfe erkennt Mac schließlich, dass Gott noch einen Plan für sein Leben hat.

programme.title: Mr. Collins' zweiter Frühling
programme.desc: In den 70er Jahren war Rockmusiker Danny Collins (Al Pacino) ein Megastar und Hit-Garant. Jetzt, über vierzig Jahre später, wird er von einer verpassten Chance wieder eingeholt. Denn nachdem er von seinem Manager Frank Grubman (Christopher Plummer) einen Brief erhält, den John Lennon ihm 1971 persönlich geschrieben hat, beginnt er seinen bisherigen Rock'n'Roll-Lifestyle zu überdenken. Dabei knüpft er nicht nur erstmals Kontakte zu seinem entfremdeten Sohn Tom Donnelly (Bobby Cannavale) und dessen Frau Samantha (Jennifer Garner), sondern auch zu der charmanten Hotelmanagerin Mary Sinclair (Annette Bening), die eigentlich so gar nicht dem Beuteschema des alternden Stars entspricht und ihm entsprechend skeptisch gegenübertritt...

programme.title: Hacked – Kein Leben ist sicher (Black Hill Pictures)
Der lange Ritt nach Westen
programme.desc: Mehrere Männer jagen einen blutrünstigen Killer, wissen aber nicht, dass Jack Fowler, dem sie nachspüren, tatsächlich unschuldig ist. Fowler versucht indessen, den Gesetzesmännern immer einen Schritt voraus zu sein und ihnen zu entgehen, während er selbst nach dem wahren Killer sucht, um so seine Unschuld zu beweisen. Doch ist er wirklich so unbescholten?

programme.title: The Jacket
programme.desc: Jack Starks (Adrien Brody) bekommt im Golfkrieg eine Kugel in den Kopf und wird nach Hause geschickt. Aufgrund des traumatischen Erlebnisses leidet er unter Amnesie. Zurück in der Heimat wird er plötzlich mit einem Mord an einem Cop in Verbindung gebracht, an den er sich jedoch nicht erinnern kann. Um aufzuklären, was wirklich geschah, wird er in eine Nervenheilanstalt eingewiesen und mit schweren Psychopharmaka behandelt. Dort ist er den experimentellen Methoden von Dr. Becker (Kris Kristofferson) hilflos ausgeliefert. Der sperrt ihn in eine Zwangsjacke, verpackt in einen Leichenschrank. Starks hyperventiliert, hat albtraumhafte Visionen, die ihm seinen baldigen Tod offenbaren und kann in die Zukunft reisen. Fieberhaft versucht er nun, das Geflecht aus Vergangenheit und Zukunft, aus Wahrheit und Fantasie zu entwirren und seinen Tod aufzuhalten...

programme.title: Der Poseidon Anschlag Teil 1
programme.desc: An Bord des Luxus-Liners Poseidon freut sich jeder auf die große Neujahrsfeier. Zu diesem Zeitpunkt weiß kaum jemand, welche Gefahr unter ihnen lauert: Ein Terrorist mit einer explosiven Nachricht an die Welt! programme.title: Dreamland - Flucht Ins Leben
programme.desc: Texas in den 1930er Jahren: Die Große Depression hat das Land fest im Griff, und der junge Eugene Evans (Finn Cole, bekannt aus Peaky Blinders) träumt davon, seiner trostlosen Kleinstadt zu entkommen. Als er auf die verwundete Bankräuberin Allison Wells (Margot Robbie) stößt, die sich in der Gegend versteckt, steht Eugene vor einer folgenschweren Entscheidung. Hin- und hergerissen zwischen der Aussicht auf das Kopfgeld für ihre Gefangennahme und seiner wachsenden Anziehungskraft zu der verführerischen Verbrecherin, gerät Eugene in ein gefährliches Spiel aus Leidenschaft und Verrat. Nichts ist so, wie es scheint – und die Wahl, die er trifft, wird das Leben aller, die er jemals geliebt hat, für immer verändern.

Nun, auf der Flucht vor Menschen, die an ihren Fähigkeiten interessiert sind, zieht es sie zurück in die Heimat und zu ihrer Familie. En la casa de Fabián están Pastor | Olegario y Junior hablando de la menopausia de Briggite. Todos están de acuerdo que obligatoriamente tiene que casarse con Jesica.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: La Discusión con Atanasio la dejó muy mal parada. Atanasio dijo que no tenía nada que contarle a ella | que iba a esperar que llegara Briggite y lo resolvería a ese nivel. programme.desc: Las intrigas de Katiuska no tienen límite; logra usurpar el poder en la empresa Tariffi y manipula a Celia sacándole información clave. Su desorden obliga a Ricardo y Manuela a interrumpir su luna de miel en Miami. Celia, renovada y decidida, se prepara para recuperar a Ricardo. Por otro lado, Gustavo cae en excesos y Marcelo enfrenta crisis en su matrimonio con Graciela. La tensión estalla cuando Manuela le exige a Ricardo tener un hijo de inmediato, dejándolo acorralado y sin palabras.

programme.title: Episodio 5
programme.desc: Las mentiras de Katiuska envuelven a Celia, convenciéndola de un falso matrimonio con Ricardo, aunque Elizabeth ve a través de su hipocresía. En la mansión, el deseo de Manuela por ser madre pone en jaque a Ricardo. Durante una salida, un encuentro fortuito revela a Manuela la existencia del pasado oculto de su esposo, sembrando en ella la semilla de la duda. Mientras Marcelo enfrenta una crisis matrimonial severa, Manuela jura descubrir si esa misteriosa mujer aún es dueña de Ricardo.

programme.title: Episodio 6
programme.desc: El drama se intensifica cuando Manuela jura destruir su matrimonio si descubre que Ricardo la engaña. Celia, aconsejada por Jade, ejecuta un papel perfecto que logra doblegar a Ricardo, haciéndole retomar sus visitas furtivas. Katiuska acecha desde las sombras, jurando destruir la felicidad de los recién casados. Paralelamente, el infierno de Gustavo con las drogas se agrava, amenazando a la familia Bustamante. Manuela y Ricardo caminan por la cuerda floja del engaño y la traición.

programme.title: Episodio 7
programme.desc: La red de mentiras asfixia a Ricardo, quien sucumbe a su obsesión y vuelve a hacerle el amor a Celia, traicionando a Manuela tras firmar un importante contrato. Paralelamente, Gustavo toca fondo con su adicción a las drogas y es internado de emergencia en Hogares Crea. Mientras los enredos amorosos entre Marcelo y Verónica se complican, el terror se apodera de Manuela: una escalofriante llamada anónima con la voz de Celia regresa para atormentarla y quebrar su aparente felicidad.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog

programme.sub-title: Close Encounters of the Sonic Kind

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik's momma escapes from the home for mothers of villains and demands her birthday present! When she endangers Sonic and Tails, and they manage to have her taken back to the home, even Robotnik is glad to see her go.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Coconuts is exiled by Robotnik to a remote jungle, where he uses a giant baby ape to destroy villages. But Sonic exposes Coconuts as a robot, and the baby ape's real Dad takes Coconuts and the baby ape away for a spanking.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: A country and western singer released a song about Sonic which is making Dr. Robotnik mad and builds a music destroyer robot.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: An energetic salesman named Wes Weasley sells Robotnik numerous gadgets to help Scratch and Grounder capture Sonic. However, Robotnik later comes to regret it when Weaseley's gadgets keep backfiring.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic and Tails rescue Lucas, Robotnik's first prisoner, and attempt to reunite him with his girlfriend, Lucinda. However, Robotnik is also in love with Lucinda, and pursues Lucas.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: En route to stop a train of explosives from arriving at Robotnik's munition factory, Sonic and Tails must deal with a duo of bears named Big Griz and Big Mike after Scratch and Grounder tell them that Sonic and Tails are the enemies.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik takes Professor Von Schlemmer hostage and uses his growth machine to try and enlarge himself. Sonic must keep the famished Tails from getting into more danger as Robotnik tricks the citizens into thinking that Sonic is the villain, while Robotnik is the hero planning to save the city.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When Sonic decides to find Tails a suitable foster home to ensure his safety, Robotnik finds out and creates a robot fox family, who pose as Tails' long-lost parents.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When overweight, elderly superhero Captain Rescue bungles in his attempts to help Sonic, he grows tired of his incompetence. Robotnik then uses Captain Rescue to successfully imprison Sonic in an impenetrable force field, and Tails and Captain Rescue must save him.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Scratch suffers a blow to the head and believes that he is his favorite television character, Edgar Eagle. Sonic uses this to his advantage in preventing another of Robotnik's schemes.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: There is a Sonic Appreciation Day happening where Sonic is the guest in a hotel. However, someone steals his power sneakers and now Sonic and Tails have to find the culprit.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Tails adopts a cute and fuzzy pet named Walter who turns out to be a black hole who sucks up everything in Mobius. Realizing that Walter is from another dimension our heroes have to return him and they soon find themselves spinning through interdimensional limbo.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When Robotnik opens up a resort to make the resident Mobians his slaves, Sonic enlists the help of some robots from an area of Mobius called Scrap Valley.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik creates a robot Sonic suit with the intent of ruining the hedgehog's reputation. He forces a lab rat named Laurence to pilot by threatening his parents.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Dr. Robotnik creates a genius chip so he would have enough brains to rule Mobius, however a computer hacker got hold of it which then the chip landed inside Grounder causing him to be smart.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic leaves Tails in charge of protecting a squirrel village food supply, when he zips off to stop a dam from breaking. When Tails is finally caught, Sonic speeds back to save him.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik introduces the Ultra Freeze-O-Matic, announcing his plan to freeze every citizen on Mobius so that he can install Servitude Chips into the frozen citizens and make them unquestionably obedient. Sonic and Tails must foil the scheme.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When Robotnik invades Labyrinth, an underwater city, and kidnaps Princess Bubbles, a seahorse-dude named Surff seeks Sonic's help. It seems Surff and the Princess are in love, but the royal family deems Surff unworthy. Sonic, Tails and Surff must avoid the undersea traps and Mobius sea monsters while Sonic rescues the Princess and reunites her with Surff -- making it look like Surff did the whole thing.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik reprograms a machine created by Von Schlemmer capable of turning dreams into reality, unleashing a Nightmare Monster upon Mobius.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When S and G rocket to outer space to mine a radioactive mineral from asteroids, Sonic and Tails stow away. programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik plans to block out the sun and extinguish all life and nature on the planet Mobius. Then he creates a robot son and tries to train him in the ways of wickedness. programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic joins up with a group of Dr. Robotnik's rejects who have been banished to the dump and helps them understand that their shortcomings were really their strengths.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: When a Rebel Base is threatened by Robotnik, Sonic and Tails team up with Big Mike and Da Bears to run a booby-trapped gauntlet in their gigantic Road Warrior-like truck, breaking through every obstacle S and G put in their way until they save the rebels.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik pretends to retire, and lures Sonic and Tails into a phony vacation resort, laden with booby-traps set by Scratch and Grounder. But Sonic takes the bungee jumping, hang gliding, and skydiving in stride, and gives the bashes the bots.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik and a rival named Quark Rex try to cooperate in capturing Sonic. However, Sonic tricks them into becoming enemies, and they try to outdo each other.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Coconuts acquires a magic wand and magical gadgets from Wes Weasley (after agreeing to forward all payments to Robotnik), and attempts to master them. Meanwhile, Robotnik tries to change Sonic-themed mobium banknotes into Robotnik banknotes in the Mobius Mint.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.sub-title: Super Special Sonic Search and Smash Squad
programme.desc: When Sonic and Tails are captured by Grounder and Scratch, Sonic tricks them into letting them escape by reminiscing about how they all met. Several badniks seen early on in this episode later resurfaced in Dr. Robotnik's Mean Bean Machine.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: While on pursuit with Scratch and Grounder, Sonic and Tails hide in an underground mine which a miser mole think that they are trespassers.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic saves a female hedgehog from Scratch and Grounder which Sonic falls in love with, while Dr. Robotnik plans to flood a village by stealing the water from the Mobius reservoir.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Sonic must save a family of sloths from Dr. Robotnik's slow-motion ray, but when he himself is slowed down by Scratch and Grounder, Tails and the sloth family must take action.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Desperate to get workers to build a Robotnik statue, Dr. Robotnik opens Casino Night Zone with his pal Smiley but when Sonic stops Scratch and Grounder, Robotnik traps Tails so Sonic has to make a choice to save his pal.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik imprisons a satirical cartoonist named Sketch Lampoon for making fun of him in his comic book, much to the anger of Sonic, his biggest fan. programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Scratch, Grounder and Coconuts set up a chili-dog trap which then resulted with Tails been captured by a mysterious person so Sonic has to find Tails and for Robotnik and co to capture Sonic.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.sub-title: Close Encounters of the Sonic Kind

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog
programme.desc: Robotnik's momma escapes from the home for mothers of villains and demands her birthday present! When she endangers Sonic and Tails, and they manage to have her taken back to the home, even Robotnik is glad to see her go.

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog

programme.title: Adventures of Sonic the Hedgehog

programme.title: Venom
programme.desc: L'histoire de la naissance du personnage le plus énigmatique, complexe et badass de l'univers Marvel : VENOM ! Après avoir tout perdu, notamment sa femme et son travail, Eddy Brock (Tom Hardy) est un homme complètement abattu. programme.title: Copains pour toujours 2
programme.desc: Espérant offrir une vie plus équilibrée à sa famille, Lenny quitte l'hystérie de Hollywood et revient s'installer dans la petite ville où il a grandi. Pourtant, entre ses anciens amis, leurs enfants, les grandes brutes et les petits excités, les chauffeurs de bus fous, les flics bourrés à skis et les 400 invités d'une fête costumée complètement déchaînés, il va vite découvrir que même si vous fuyez la folie, parfois, elle vous poursuit où que vous alliez…

programme.title: Ma Vie Sans Lui
programme.desc: Une jeune femme doit faire face à la mort de son mari et à la découverte de nombreux secrets le concernant...

programme.title: Excess Baggage
programme.desc: Emily T. Hope, adolescente mal dans sa peau, tente sans succes de retenir l'attention de son cher papa. Devant ses echecs repetes, elle tente le tout pour le tout et organise son propre kidnapping. Son plan reussit. En deguisant sa voix, elle previent son pere de l'endroit ou il peut la retrouver: dans le coffre de sa propre voiture. Mais Vincent Roche, voleur professionnel, vole le vehicule.

programme.title: Où sont passés les Morgan?
programme.desc: Un couple séparé de New York est le témoin d'un meurtre et est placé sous protection des témoins dans un village du Wyoming.

programme.title: Les ex de mon mec
programme.desc: Stacy, une jeune journaliste en herbe, découvre, en regardant dans l'organizer électronique de son petit ami, qu'il a eu avant elle une suite de relations sentimentales incroyables avec, entre autres, un superbe mannequin et la voisine de palier. Elle décide de toutes les rencontrer...

programme.title: Jerry Maguire
programme.desc: Riche, beau et célèbre, Jerry Maguire, agent des stars du sport americain, l'est. Mais sa vie mondaine et factice lui pèse, et une nuit il se remet en question dans une note qu'il rédige, où il tente de définir le sens qu'il voudrait donner à sa vie. Cette note va provoquer son licenciement et tous ses amis vont le trahir.

programme.title: Mange Prie Aime
programme.desc: Elizabeth Gilbert, auteure new-yorkaise de 28 ans, a tout pour être heureuse : un mari, un grand appartement… Mais un jour, elle se rend compte qu'elle ne retrouve plus dans sa vie, qu'elle est vide d'émotion, qu'elle a perdu son appétit de la vie. Après un divorce douloureux, puis une relation insatisfaisante avec un jeune acteur, elle entreprend un voyage d'un an d'abord à Rome, puis dans un ashram en Inde et enfin à Bali.

programme.title: Pour Le Pire Et Pour Le Meilleur
programme.desc: Melvin Udall, un écrivain misanthrope, écrit à la chaîne des romans sentimentaux qui comblent son sens pervers de l'autoridérision et lui permettent de vivre confortablement. Sa vie est réglée comme du papier à musique, il évite le contact humain hormis celui de Carol Connelly, une jeune mère célibataire, serveuse dans un restaurant où il prend ses repas.

programme.title: Rien Que Pour Vos Cheveux
programme.desc: Agent d'élite du Mossad et véritable star dans son pays, Zohan (Adam Sandler) rêve de devenir coiffeur en Amérique. Profitant d'un combat contre son pire ennemi, connu sous le nom de Fantôme, Zohan se fait passer pour mort et s'envole pour New York armé uniquement de ses ciseaux et de son sèche-cheveux. Malgré son inexpérience, il est engagé par la patronne d'un salon de coiffure, une jolie Palestinienne. Alors que son passé d'agent semble loin derrière lui, Zohan est repéré par le Fantôme, qui compte bien en finir avec lui une bonne fois pour toutes...

programme.title: Freaks of Nature
programme.desc: Dans la ville de Dillford, vampires, humains et zombies sont habitué de vivre ensemble, mais avec l'arrivée d'extraterrestres, il se produit que les humains commence à se battre contre les vampires et les Zombies dans un combat mortel. Trois adolescents doivent maintenant essayer de faire revenir les choses à la «normale».

programme.title: Sony One | Séries Comédie
programme.desc: Séries de comédies à mourir de rire pour une expérience relax et enjouée parfaite à partager en famille et avec des amis.

programme.title: Sony One | Séries Thriller

programme.title: Love And The Radio Star
programme.desc: Savannah is hired to rebrand New York's #4 radio show host. But when she accidentally ends up on the air with the host, she becomes part of the show's rebranding herself and discovers if on-air differences or love will have the last word.

programme.title: A Missed Connection
programme.desc: After finding a spark with a woman on a train platform, a photographer posts a missed connection in the newspaper but never hears from her. Five years later, they meet again while on the way to the same wedding – hers.

programme.title: Moving McAllister
programme.desc: Rick Robinson is a ladder-climbing law intern from Miami with four days until the Bar Exam. Desperate to score points with his boss (McAllister), he commits to a favor he can't afford. He ends up in a rundown truck headed to L.A. with his boss's possessions, his Hollywood-bound niece, and her pet pig. Amidst hitch-hikers, breakdowns, and assorted local yokels, Rick finds love, life and maybe himself in this trans-American road trip from hell.

programme.title: Braving Rapids
programme.desc: A family goes on a river rafting trip as they process a great loss. Along the way they find a wolf pup. When some unscrupulous folks spot the wolf as well and conspire to steal and sell it, the family and guides fight to protect the pup. Could their journey to deliver the wolf safely to wildlife officials be just the thing to guide them to healing?

programme.title: Love Finds You in Sugarcreek
programme.desc: A father and son fleeing a shocking and brutal tragedy settle in the predominantly Amish town of Sugarcreek, Ohio. They are taken in by three sisters who offer the father work as a handyman, but a local policewoman begins to become suspicious of his past.

programme.title: Love in Tahiti
programme.desc: Brielle has always believed the ocean floor is full of treasures just waiting to be found. Over the years she has dived to find coins, lost jewelry and more in the waters of Tahiti. Instead of profiting from them, she loves reuniting people with their lost valuables. When she finds a class ring and returns it to Marcus, a handsome US Navy serviceman, Brielle soon discovers what has been missing in her life – a treasure of the heart.

programme.desc: Megan seems to have the perfect life with a wonderful husband named Thomas and 2 adorable children. Then she finds herself awakening from a coma – and discovers she is not and has never been married. But when she meets Thomas for real, she seizes the chance to help him fall in love with her, again—for the first time.

programme.desc: General Motors VP of global design Ed Welburn takes AmeriCarna behind the scenes to talk about the history and development of the company’s concept cars that never made it to production. In a rare tour of the factory’s inner design studio, Ray gets an exclusive look behind the creative curtain at the GM plant in Detroit.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: In this episode, Ray celebrates the 50th birthday of the Ford Mustang through the lens of three distinct Mustang owners, who each hold a slice of the car’s incredible history. In 1964, Chicago schoolteacher Gail Wise unknowingly purchased the first ever Mustang 3 days before the car became available to the general public. Her husband reveals the incredible restoration that brought the earliest Mustang ever sold back to its 60’s glory. (Ford Motor Company knows she has the car and has verified it was sold before it was legal to sell.) John Grafelman is a farmer in Illinois and life-long Ford lover. A few years ago he found an old car hidden in a barn. It took some time, but he eventually convinced his friend to sell it to him. After some detective work, he discovers he purchased 1968 Ford Design Chief Larry Shinoda’s personal car that he tinkered with to invent the BOSS 302.Lastly, Ray travels to Dayton Ohio to interview Gale Holderman, the Ford stylist who won the company’s contest to draw and design the Mustang.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Post-World War II, a large generation of American soldiers was looking for cars that mirrored the incredible sports cars they saw overseas in Europe. After searching for an affordable way to recreate these cars, one manufacturer responded with a durable, cost effective option: a line of fiberglass sports cars. Very few of these cars still exist but there are collectors who are constantly looking to save parts and pieces of these virtually unknown vehicles. We learn about these rare cars from Geoff Hacker and his team at Forgotten Fiberglass, and take a visit to the Smithsonian Museum, which houses a fiberglass car of its own. This episode presents a unique look at how the narrative of American wartime experiences often shaped the nation’s automotive demands.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Ray explores buying a unique, hand built car the Schultz family has kept in their New Jersey home for years. The car was originally called the Schultz El Fierro but it’s officially titled in New Jersey as a “Schultz Special” from 1958. It was used to drag race and held numerous racing records, but most important to the family was that it was driven by the legendary Carroll Shelby. With a frame and style much similar to the Shelby Roadster, the Schultz family wonders if it inspired one of the most well known automobiles in America. In another epic New Jersey story, Ray finds Mario Andretti’s 1965 IndyCar. The catch: it’s completely in pieces hidden away in a garage. The iconic driver talks about his days on the track with that car and Ray attempts to negotiate a deal to buy the parts.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: How do you cast a car in a movie? What are the secrets to the build? Hollywood car designers give Ray the ultimate tour of some memorable movie cars, including a look at the recently found “Hells Chariot”, the last surviving car from Grease. We also hear the backstory to “Bumble Bee” from Transformers, take a look at the making of the tanks for Hunger Games and stumble upon the iconic 1958 Chevy Impala from American Graffiti.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: While visiting the estate of automotive genius and land speed record holder Willie Glass, Ray uncovers a set of extremely rare Ardun cylinder heads, which is a hot rodders dream discovery. He also visits the infamous H & H Flatheads outside of Los Angeles and discovers a surprise connection to the Earnhardt family.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: A massive sinkhole opened underneath the National Corvette Museum in Kentucky. Eight amazing cars were swallowed up, including the 1,000,000th Corvette. AmeriCarna was given exclusive access to document the removal of the cars from the sinkhole and the painstaking restoration of the 1,000,000th Corvette.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: On the beaches of Wildwood, NJ, an iconic vintage race, The Race of Gentleman, takes place annually: period cars, period dress, pure authenticity. Ray puts a car in the race with a very special driver, who turns out not to be a Gentleman.

programme.title: AmeriCarna
programme.desc: Scott Borchetta, CEO and Founder of Big Machine Label Group, and his brother, Mark, love racing just as much as anyone. Timmy is a gifted little footballer who needs to learn that it’s not enough to kick the ball – you have to pass it too. Harriet Heron and Osbourne Owl, who run the Nursery are going to have their hands full, but Timmy gets it right in the end with a little help from his friends of the furry, feathery and spikey type.

programme.title: THE WAWIES
programme.desc: Wawaland is a tiny world within planet Earth. So small and light that it gets carried away by the wind. Right now, it could be flying over Tokyo, Paris, or the Atlantic Ocean, completely unseen by humans. In this magical place live The Wawies—chubby and curious beings who are always asking questions and trying to make sense of the world around them and ours. Through Sha’s far-away glasses, the Wawies can observe how humans behave on Earth and apply what they learn in their own world, sparking endless adventures that teach them, entertain them, help them explore their surroundings, and listen to themselves. They always stick together and never leave anyone behind. For example, this season, you might find them competing in their own version of Wawachef,” escaping from some not-so-friendly monkeys, deciding to ban rules in their world forever, trying to calm down some feisty ants, training their patience to care for a garden, or figuring out which costume party is more fun: Halloween or Carnival. With each adventure, Sha, Opo, Aca, Bow, and Tok strive to understand, grow, and have fun. And along the way, they’ll unintentionally create their own set of rules to live in a place where respect and harmony with their surroundings are key. With its playful and cheerful tone, Wawaland seeks to show children a different way of seeing things—helping them appreciate the world around them and, most importantly, themselves.

programme.title: Storytellers
programme.desc: It’s that time again—when the boys from StruttinBuck load up and head out of Arkansas, bound for Fairfield, Texas and the FE Hill Ranch. Another year, another hunt, and another chapter in a tradition that’s grown into something far bigger than the hunt itself. This annual father-son trip is built on early mornings, shared stories, and moments that stick with you long after the season ends. It’s the memories made over the years that keep calling them back—and this year will be no different.

programme.title: Storytellers

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.sub-title: "Hunting Giant Eurasian Brown Bear in Croatia"
programme.desc: Join Mark Peterson as he embarks on a thrilling hunt in Croatia for the Eurasian Brown Bear. Experience the beauty of the Croatian wilderness and witness the skill and precision required for a successful hunt. Follow along as Mark faces all the challenges dealing with wind and a big bear that is extremely smart, making it very difficult to harvest this amazing animal. Don’t miss this exciting hunting adventure with Mark Peterson in Croatia!

programme.title: The Journey Within
programme.sub-title: "Northern Cape of South Africa: Axis and Fallow Deer"
programme.desc: Through the rugged terrain of South Africa's Northern Cape, Mark Peterson sets out in pursuit of a rare and thrilling double, the Axis and Fallow Deer. Though non-native, these species have flourished in the region's diverse habitat. Join Mark on this unforgettable experience under the African skies, during this unique hunting experience in South Africa.

programme.title: Chasin' The Sun
programme.desc: We listen to guides and anglers on how they attempt to hook into the migrating tarpon that pass thru PCB’s beautiful beach waters each summer. It’s a lesson in humility, respect and yes....luck.

programme.title: Chasin' The Sun
programme.desc: Capt. Justin Leake and a fellow guide search for redfish along the beach, but Mother Nature has other ideas and gives them a show they didn’t expect.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Everything is bigger in Texas, including the stories. With the whitetail rut in the midwest winding down, the Winchester Life Crew of Chris Keefer, Casey Keefer, Nikki Boxler and Paul Sawyer head south to the Texas Panhandle with Winchesters in hand hoping to wrangle in a few Texas-sized giants.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: The positive impact made by the shooting sports and recreational shooting to people across our country can’t be measured in just one story, so we have three. In Florida, Olympian Dania Vizzi trains at her home shooting facility and talk about how she went from ballerina to one of the best shotgun shooters in the world. In Nebraska, firearms instructor Thea Van Syoc has used the disciplines of competitive pistol shooting and training to help shape her life. Finally we’ll take a look into the National African American Gun Association and learn how one day at the range for Phillip Smith created the fastest growing firearm organization in the United States.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Illinois isn’t the first state you think about when it comes to waterfowl, but the Wentz Brothers have dialed in some honey holes over the years. On this episode, a slew of waterfowl experts put to the test some of the newest Winchester waterfowl ammunition during the great migration of the Mississippi Flyway in early December. We’ll also head north to the shores of Kodiak Island, Alaska with Chris and Casey Keefer as they push the limits of Winchester’s new Last Call Double Shot on fast-ripping sea ducks. - GUESTS: Zach Wentz (Team Winchester) Nathan Robinson (Winchester Ammunition) Ryan Swaner (Winchester Repeating Arms) Chris Jennings (Ducks Unlimited) Mike Brasher (Ducks Unlimited) Scott Olmsted (American Hunter) Travis Hall (Field & Stream) Chris Keefer (Team Winchester) Casey Keefer (Team Winchester)

programme.title: Behind The Draw
programme.desc: After 3 years of Encounters with Alvin the Story has finally come to an end! Alvin has made his presence known over many encounter's over the years but he continued to get the pass until he became 5.5 years old. 2023 Season had finally arrived and Alvin was one of the bucks that had finally reached his full potential. Rex goes throughout the season with many close calls but finally after sneaking into Alvin's core area he gets to wrap his tag around a buck we know very well!

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: The Angry Planet team heads to Africa to climb the steep and very active Nyiragongo Volcano in the Congo that erupted in 2002, sending 125,000 people fleeing for their lives. Host/adventurer George Kourounis explores the bubbling lake of molten lava and investigates the risk the dangerous volcano poses to both the people of city of Goma and the Mountain Gorillas who live on the nearby jungle slopes.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.sub-title: Angry Planet | The Winds of Autumn
programme.desc: The autumn of 2006 brings hurricanes to the North Atlantic and hot dry winds fan forest fires across Northern Ontario. Host/adventurer George Kourounis has traveled to some awesome hurricanes, including Rita and Katrina, with his pal Mark Robinson. This year they stormchase in Newfoundland, site of the hurricane that pulled Mark out of a life-threatening depression.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: Host George Kourounis has braved many terrifying phenomena – but none as frightening as the one he takes on in this episode: marriage! To make sure his new bride is on the same adventurous page with him, he proposes to get married on the lip of an exploding volcano, on the South Pacific island of Tanna, in Vanuatu. Before the native preacher, dressed in grass skirt and kustom garb, gets to perform the smoky vows, George descends into the erupting volcano to bring out red hot samples of the lava it is producing.

programme.title: Angry Planet
programme.desc: Avalanche danger is very high in the Rogers Pass area of the Trans Canada Highway in British Columbia. Host of Angry Planet George Kourounis travels with a variety of experts to bring down huge avalanches in the Rocky Mountains. Ski Patrollers throw hand charges to clear the slopes, the British Columbia Department of Highways uses helicopter bombing and mountaintop mortars to keep the roads safe, and the Canadian Armed Forces fire 105mm howitzers at the mountains to bring down the dangerous snow. Still, there are accidents and fatalities in the mountains. We meet Francois Desroisers, an avalanche burial victim who tells a terrible and tragic tale of a mountain disaster.
